description: Rule 4.4A (DEC 2026-11-12; design approved by the PFM 19 Nov 26): when a PFM Waivers row has Tier T-0, T-1 or T-2 and its Waiver Approver is a wing person (the Leader of any PFM Offices row, by e-mail), writes one PFM Activity Log row (Event Type Waiver Warning, title Waiver tier warning: W<ID>, with the tier and the Table A10.1 approver for it) and sends one e-mail to the alert address with a link to the waiver row. Once only per waiver, tier and approver (the Activity Log row is the memory, as in F03), so an unrelated edit does not warn again; a change of tier or approver does. Never changes the waiver row: a warning, not a block. DAFMAN 90-161 Attachment 10, Table A10.1: T-0 is not waivable by the DAF; T-1 and T-2 go to the MAJCOM/CC (ANG: NGB/CF, delegable no lower than ANGRC/CC); T-3 is waived at the wing (no warning). Checks every 15 minutes, one run at a time, as F01. Stops when Flows paused is Yes; e-mails the alert address when a step fails.

Get_settings.description: R27 (PFM 14 Nov 26): the flow values are rows of PFM Settings, read once at the start. F08 reads only Flows paused (missing or empty: No).

Approver_email.description: The Waiver Approver's e-mail, lower case, to compare with the Leader e-mail of each PFM Offices row

Get_offices.description: Every PFM Offices row, active or not: a wing person is the Leader of any row (design 4.4A; no directory lookup, no search outside the site)

Warning_key.description: Once only (the F03 memory pattern): a warning row of this waiver whose details start with this tier and approver means it was sent

parameters.$filter: @concat('Title eq ''', concat('Waiver tier warning: W', string(triggerBody()?['ID'])), '''')

Table_A10_1_approver.inputs: @if(equals(outputs('Tier'), 'T-0'), 'T-0: not waivable by the DAF; relief goes through command channels to the HQ DAF OPR', if(equals(outputs('Tier'), 'T-1'), 'T-1: the MAJCOM/CC waives; for the ANG, NGB/CF, delegable no lower than ANGRC/CC', 'T-2: the MAJCOM/CC waives; for the ANG, NGB/CF, delegable no lower than ANGRC/CC, also to NGB Directors'))
Table_A10_1_approver.description: DAFMAN 90-161 Attachment 10, Table A10.1: who waives a requirement of this tier (design 4.4A)

parameters.item/EventDetails: @concat(outputs('Warning_key'), ' the Waiver Approver is a wing leader (Leader of ', string(length(body('Wing_leader_rows'))), ' PFM Offices row(s)). Table A10.1 approver: ', outputs('Table_A10_1_approver'), '. Waiver row W', string(triggerBody()?['ID']), ' not changed (a warning, not a block).')

Log_waiver_warning.description: The memory row: Event Type Waiver Warning (a T19 r6 choice), title Waiver tier warning: W<ID>

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('90-161.Z waiver tier warning: W', string(triggerBody()?['ID']), ' (', outputs('Tier'), ')')
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@concat('

A waiver in PFM Waivers names a wing leader as its Waiver Approver, but its tier is waived above the wing (DAFMAN 90-161, Attachment 10, Table A10.1).

', '

Waiver row: W', string(triggerBody()?['ID']), ' ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['Title'], ''), '
Tier: ', outputs('Tier'), '
Waiver Approver: ', outputs('Approver_email'), ' (the Leader of ', string(length(body('Wing_leader_rows'))), ' PFM Offices row(s))', '
Table A10.1 approver for this tier: ', outputs('Table_A10_1_approver'), '

', '

What to do: check the waiver and its record. If the record is wrong, correct the Waiver Approver or the Tier; if the waiver was approved at the wing, it needs the approver above. ', if(empty(coalesce(triggerBody()?['{Link}'], '')), 'Open the waiver row in PFM Waivers.', concat('Open the waiver row.')), '

', '

The flow changed nothing on the waiver row. It warns once for this waiver, tier and approver; a change of tier or approver warns again.

', '

This message is sent by the 90-161.Z publications flow.

')

E-mail_the_warning.description: One e-mail to the alert address only (PFM 19 Nov 26), with a link to the waiver row

If_wing_leader.description: Rule 4.4A (DEC 2026-11-12): Tier T-0, T-1 or T-2 and the Waiver Approver is a wing leader. T-3 is waived at the wing (Table A10.1): no warning

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@concat('

A 90-161.Z flow stopped with an error. Nothing after the failed step ran.

', '

Flow: ', coalesce(workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName'], 'F08'), '
Started: ', convertTimeZone(utcNow(), 'UTC', 'Central Standard Time', 'dd MMM yy HHmm'), ' Central', '
Waiver row: W', string(triggerBody()?['ID']), '

', '

Failed step:

    ', join(body('Failure_lines'), ''), '
', '

What to do: 1. Open the failed run: run details (or open this flow and its 28-day run history; the failed run has the start time above). 2. Fix the cause the step names (for example a list name or a connection). 3. Select Resubmit on that run: the flow starts again from the beginning and adds only what is missing.

', '

This message is sent by the 90-161.Z publications flow.

')

runError.message: A step failed; the alert address was e-mailed. Fix the cause, then Resubmit this run.
